S_lts_harbor_phase_inland.name: Harbor Phase — Inland City
S_lts_harbor_phase_inland.description: Safe, automated, UBI-stabilized, optimized, comfortable, and emotionally flattening. The city adapted by moving inland rather than collapsing.
S_lts_harbor_phase_inland.visual_language: gray-blue rain, raised transit, glass, flood-control gates, public-service UI, soft civic lighting, automated maintenance, people housed and stable but unused
S_lts_harbor_phase_inland.story_function: Shows managed adulthood: everything works, nothing demands enough from the characters.

S_lts_harbor_phase.name: Harbor Phase — Civic Systems View
S_lts_harbor_phase.description: A wide civic view of inland Harbor Phase: elevated transit, floodwalls, automated freight, public-service interfaces, and working flood-control systems.
S_lts_harbor_phase.visual_language: gray-blue rain, raised rail, flood-control gates, civic screens, automated vehicles, orderly public infrastructure, wet glass and concrete
S_lts_harbor_phase.story_function: Opening proof that the world did not collapse; it became managed enough to flatten ordinary agency.

S_lts_harbor_phase_transit.name: Harbor Phase — Elevated Transit
S_lts_harbor_phase_transit.description: Raised transit line above the floodwall and adapted shoreline streets, moving people through a safe city that has learned to absorb inconvenience.
S_lts_harbor_phase_transit.visual_language: rain-streaked train windows, floodwalls below, calm passenger interiors, civic route displays, water managed by systems outside the glass
S_lts_harbor_phase_transit.story_function: Frames Matt inside a system that works before he can meaningfully act.

S_lts_municipal_control_room.name: Harbor Phase — Municipal Control Room
S_lts_municipal_control_room.description: A clean, quiet civic operations room where human oversight confirms automated drainage and maintenance decisions already made by the system.
S_lts_municipal_control_room.visual_language: blue-gray monitors, drainage maps, drone feeds, calm alert language, rain on glass, rows of underused human workstations
S_lts_municipal_control_room.story_function: Shows Matt's proximity to responsibility without much actual agency.

S_lts_harbor_phase_walkway.name: Harbor Phase — Managed Walkways
S_lts_harbor_phase_walkway.description: Covered pedestrian routes, civic signs, planters, continuity-payment screens, and managed public life that is safe but emotionally thin.
S_lts_harbor_phase_walkway.visual_language: wet paving, planted walkways, umbrellas, soft civic lighting, friendly public-service signs, clean glass and concrete
S_lts_harbor_phase_walkway.story_function: Shows the comfort and airlessness of inland life.

S_lts_inland_montage.name: Harbor Phase — Managed Adulthood Montage
S_lts_inland_montage.description: Homes, small workshops, gyms, screens, old tools, and automated systems showing how each lead has a life that functions but does not fully need them.
S_lts_inland_montage.visual_language: practical interiors, blue-gray screens, rain outside windows, underused equipment, half-finished personal projects, soft domestic and workshop light
S_lts_inland_montage.story_function: Introduces the ensemble's ordinary redundancy before the Reach gives them friction.

S_lts_inland_bar.name: Harbor Phase — Inland Bar
S_lts_inland_bar.description: A pleasant, slightly over-managed bar where the old friend group gathers before the first run.
S_lts_inland_bar.visual_language: warm interior light against rain, civic screens in corners, polished surfaces, booths, pints, too much comfort, not enough consequence
S_lts_inland_bar.story_function: Lets the adult friend-group dynamic emerge before the Reach interrupts it.

S_lts_inland_homes.name: Harbor Phase — Inland Homes and Prep Spaces
S_lts_inland_homes.description: Apartments, workshops, lockers, and kitchen tables where the group packs practical gear for the low-tide crossing.
S_lts_inland_homes.visual_language: bags, boots, headlamps, tide screens, folded printouts, cracked devices, rain-lit windows, practical clutter
S_lts_inland_homes.story_function: Turns the rumor into a physical decision: they are actually going.

S_lts_floodwall_ferry_lot.name: Floodwall / Old Ferry Lot
S_lts_floodwall_ferry_lot.description: Edge of inhabited Harbor Phase where tide runners gather with cheap gear before descending to the flats.
S_lts_floodwall_ferry_lot.visual_language: open trunks, wet pavement, headlamps, contractor work lights, tide boards, cheap gear, cold mist, floodwall mass
S_lts_floodwall_ferry_lot.story_function: Threshold between managed inland life and the Reach.

S_lts_flood_steps.name: Floodwall Steps
S_lts_flood_steps.type: descent point from Harbor Phase onto the flats
S_lts_flood_steps.description: Concrete steps and service access at the old ferry lot where runners descend from protected civic infrastructure onto exposed seabed.
S_lts_flood_steps.visual_language: wet concrete stairs, headlamps, warning boards, black mud below, floodwall looming behind, practical lights only
S_lts_flood_steps.story_function: The literal crossing threshold: comfort ends and physical consequence begins.

S_lts_flats.name: The Flats
S_lts_flats.description: Mud, old pavement, broken pilings, shallow pools, road fragments, channels, fog, and distance between Harbor Phase and the Reach.
S_lts_flats.visual_language: black tidal mud, boot suction, shell crunch, weak practical lights, fog swallowing depth, Harbor Phase dim behind
S_lts_flats.story_function: Physicalizes risk, effort, silence, dependence, and the fact that reaching the Reach costs the body something.

S_lts_flats_service_roads.name: The Flats — Exposed Service Roads
S_lts_flats_service_roads.description: Old submerged service road markings and access fragments emerge from mud as the crossing approaches offshore construction geometry.
S_lts_flats_service_roads.visual_language: broken road lines under black mud, rusted signs, shell debris, headlamp beams, rain, distant massive forms in fog
S_lts_flats_service_roads.story_function: Shows that the group is not just walking on seabed; they are crossing the remains of planned access into the offshore future.

S_lts_flats_sector_14.name: The Flats — Sector 14 Fragments
S_lts_flats_sector_14.description: Concrete foundations, transit fragments, and damaged Sector 14 signage protrude from the flats.
S_lts_flats_sector_14.visual_language: half-buried sign panels, concrete stubs, old transit markings, black water channels, fog and practical work lights
S_lts_flats_sector_14.story_function: Confirms the Reach's scale through physical evidence rather than exposition.

S_lts_reach_first_sight.name: The Reach — First Sight
S_lts_reach_first_sight.type: first view of abandoned offshore district
S_lts_reach_first_sight.description: The vast unfinished offshore district emerges through fog beyond the flats, too large to be dismissed as outskirts.
S_lts_reach_first_sight.visual_language: tower silhouettes, elevated structures, rain, fog, black tidal mirror, tiny figures dwarfed between Harbor Phase and the abandoned future
S_lts_reach_first_sight.story_function: Chapter-one reveal: the Reach is not a drowned neighborhood but a future interrupted.

S_lts_near_reach.name: Near Reach / Outer Structures
S_lts_near_reach.description: Parking structures, broken pedestrian bridges, dead plazas, flooded service roads, support columns, and informal runner markings.
S_lts_near_reach.visual_language: salt-stained concrete, floodlines, reflective tape, runner graffiti, black water moving through lower levels
S_lts_near_reach.story_function: Shows that the Reach is dangerous but already partially domesticated by runner culture.

S_lts_reach_edge.name: The Reach Edge
S_lts_reach_edge.type: outer boundary of abandoned offshore district
S_lts_reach_edge.description: The first walkable edge of the Reach where exposed access routes, broken decks, and water channels turn rumor into physical geography.
S_lts_reach_edge.visual_language: salt-stained concrete, black channels, broken ramps, fog, high dark shapes, route decisions under headlamps
S_lts_reach_edge.story_function: Entry into Chapter 2 and transition from crossing to exploration.

S_lts_reach_runner_marks.name: The Reach — Runner Marks
S_lts_reach_runner_marks.description: Arrows, warnings, timing claims, profanity, and runner tags layered over official abandoned infrastructure.
S_lts_reach_runner_marks.visual_language: spray paint, reflective tape, scratched arrows, wet walls, crude warnings, practical beams catching letters
S_lts_reach_runner_marks.story_function: Shows the Reach becoming a folk system before it becomes a social addiction.

S_lts_near_reach_structures.name: Near Reach Structures
S_lts_near_reach_structures.description: Flooded decks, dead plazas, sagging walkways, and first audible signs of other runners farther in.
S_lts_near_reach_structures.visual_language: broken pedestrian bridges, wet metal, distant work lights, black water below, skeletal concrete, laughter in fog
S_lts_near_reach_structures.story_function: Routes the group toward Fashion Harbor Center and shows partial domestication by runners.

S_lts_reach_ramp.name: The Reach — Wet Ramp
S_lts_reach_ramp.description: A slick ramp and elevated access route used to climb from the flats into the first accessible structures.
S_lts_reach_ramp.visual_language: wet concrete incline, railings, slime, handheld lights, slipping boots, black water below
S_lts_reach_ramp.story_function: Keeps physical effort and small acts of help in the foreground.

S_lts_fashion_harbor_center.name: Fashion Harbor Center / Dead Mall
S_lts_fashion_harbor_center.description: A recent, canceled commercial-social future. Lower levels submerged, upper floors still accessible and temporarily occupied by runners.
S_lts_fashion_harbor_center.visual_language: escalators into black water, broken signage, food-court ghosts, dead advertisements, upper-level work lights, scattered runner occupation
S_lts_fashion_harbor_center.story_function: First place the Reach feels like a temporary society rather than a rumor.

S_lts_mall_atrium.name: Fashion Harbor Center — Flooded Atrium
S_lts_mall_atrium.description: The central mall void, with black water filling lower levels and escalators descending into floodwater.
S_lts_mall_atrium.visual_language: wide atrium, broken skylight, escalators into water, dead advertisements, dripping floors, practical beams over reflective black water
S_lts_mall_atrium.story_function: Lets the Reach feel familiar and wrong at once.

S_lts_mall_upper_level.name: Fashion Harbor Center — Upper Level
S_lts_mall_upper_level.description: Accessible upper floor where runners sit, argue routes, change socks, eat noodles, and rest under clipped work lights.
S_lts_mall_upper_level.visual_language: storefronts, dead kiosks, sleeping bags, headlamps, LED strips, wet tile, scattered humans making temporary use of abandoned space
S_lts_mall_upper_level.story_function: Shows the Reach's first temporary society.

S_lts_mall_atrium_hold.name: Fashion Harbor Center — Atrium Hold
S_lts_mall_atrium_hold.description: A pause above the flooded atrium where the group checks time, jokes, watches Justin wander, and feels the seduction of staying.
S_lts_mall_atrium_hold.visual_language: railing over black water, wet tile, runners in pockets of work light, damp jackets, route debates
S_lts_mall_atrium_hold.story_function: Gives the group enough safety to start treating the Reach socially.

S_lts_mall_sportswear.name: Fashion Harbor Center — Sportswear Store
S_lts_mall_sportswear.description: A half-looted sportswear store where Chris finds old branded clothing and the group roasts him.
S_lts_mall_sportswear.visual_language: fallen mannequins, damp racks, faded Harbor Phase Mariners gear, headlamp comedy, mud on glossy retail surfaces
S_lts_mall_sportswear.story_function: Turns the dead mall into a place where the group can be funny together.

S_lts_mall_detail_sequence.name: Fashion Harbor Center — Detail Sequence
S_lts_mall_detail_sequence.description: Food court, kiosks, transit access, play areas, ads, and silence; the mall still reads as designed for ordinary life.
S_lts_mall_detail_sequence.visual_language: food court signage, kiosk ghosts, play structure partly submerged, dead ads, no-signal screens, water stains
S_lts_mall_detail_sequence.story_function: Builds the emotional wrongness of a future that almost became normal.

S_lts_mall_map.name: Fashion Harbor Center — Map and Connections
S_lts_mall_map.description: Directory maps and faded route displays show the mall connected to wider transit and residential infrastructure.
S_lts_mall_map.visual_language: offline mall maps, transit arrows, cracked screens, water damage, figures huddled over bad information
S_lts_mall_map.story_function: Shows that the Reach was an integrated district, not a simple ruin.

S_lts_mall_leasing_display.name: Fashion Harbor Center — Leasing Display
S_lts_mall_leasing_display.description: Luxury residence and commercial leasing material promising a future beside black floodwater.
S_lts_mall_leasing_display.visual_language: glossy renderings, cracked display cases, model apartments, black floodwater outside, dead sales copy
S_lts_mall_leasing_display.story_function: Contrasts planned lifestyle marketing with physical abandonment.

S_lts_mall_atrium_routes.name: Fashion Harbor Center — Route Decision
S_lts_mall_atrium_routes.description: Contradictory runner advice, dangerous bridge options, and Ryan's practical route judgment inside the mall.
S_lts_mall_atrium_routes.visual_language: route graffiti, sagging bridge signs, black water visible through rails, group gathered in headlamp light
S_lts_mall_atrium_routes.story_function: Reinforces Ryan's competence and Matt's reliance on it.

S_lts_glass_rail.name: The Glass Rail
S_lts_glass_rail.description: Broken elevated rail line connecting the mall, Harbor Market, and deeper sectors; gives height, views, and false mastery.
S_lts_glass_rail.visual_language: broken panels, fog at height, black water below, skeletal supports, runner tags, wet metal
S_lts_glass_rail.story_function: A route deeper in and a stage for status, risk, and escalation.

S_lts_harbor_market_roof.name: Harbor Market Roof
S_lts_harbor_market_roof.description: Upper deck and roofline above flooded lower floors where runners gather during low tide windows.
S_lts_harbor_market_roof.visual_language: work lights clipped to conduit, people on ventilation units, cheap beer, food, fog, drowned skyline, practical lights on roofs and bridges
S_lts_harbor_market_roof.story_function: The social seduction of the Reach: no signal, direct attention, roles, and temporary belonging.

S_lts_deep_reach.name: Deep Reach
S_lts_deep_reach.type: rarely exposed far offshore civic district
S_lts_deep_reach.description: Ordinary unfinished future: schools, parks, housing, plazas, civic buildings, transit loops, clinics, community spaces.
S_lts_deep_reach.visual_language: not spectacular; devastating because it is legibly ordinary, planned, and never inhabited
S_lts_deep_reach.story_function: Final realization: the mystery is not that something happened there. Nothing happened there. Humanity simply stopped arriving.
